newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks drift a tad lower, await parliament.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks drift a tad lower, await parliament.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened flat on Monday and drifted lower as the market waited for parliament to convene in the afternoon, brokers said. They said that the market was hoping the government would propose measures to help stocks get back on their feet.
As of 0019 GMT, the Nikkei 225 was down 88.54 points or 0.40 percent at 18,001.50. Its March futures were down 110 points at 18,020.
"Depending on how the session goes, stocks could fall again, led by futures, especially since they were supported by parliamentary hopes," a traders at a foreign brokerage said.
